title: undo not possible (on an otherwise great app)
body:
I was very happy with this app on my iPhone but then noticed that it's easy to touch the unfilled circle of an item by mistake, marking it as completed as a result, and moving it out of view before I even get a chance to see what it was. An UNDO function is essential in that case, especially if dealing with a large to-do list. Without 'undo' I have to go through all completed items, one by one, hoping to recognize the item I clicked on by mistake.

On iOS you normally "shake-to-undo" and then you get a pop-up asking to confirm. That would be great.

It is an otherwise perfect app.
